CustomObject.description: Registry of make-whole formula configurations. Each record defines the reference rate source, spread, and PV method for a named make-whole formula. Debt_Position.Make_Whole_Formula__c references the DeveloperName of the applicable formula. MakeWholeCalculator reads this at prepayment time. Spec v7 Part 2.12, 6.7.3, Rule R21.
CustomObject.label: Make-Whole Formula
